# Netline UI Components Documentation

Welcome to the Netline UI component library documentation.

Netline UI is a comprehensive design system built on top of Material-UI (MUI), providing a consistent and accessible interface for Lufthansa Systems applications.

## Components by Category

### Getting started

- [Overview](./getting-started/Overview.md) - Introduction to Netline UI design system
- [Installation Guide](./getting-started/InstallationGuide.md) - How to install and set up Netline UI
- [Contributors Guide](./getting-started/ContributorsGuide.md) - Guidelines for contributing
- [Kitchensink](./getting-started/Kitchensink.md) - All components showcase
- [Changelog](./getting-started/Changelog.md) - Version history and changes
